# GPT Image prompts: characters

<!-- Generated by tool/gen_prompts.dart. Edit that file and re-run instead of editing this one. -->

Ready-to-paste prompts for every character in `docs/Charecter.md`, in a Japanese anime chibi style whose outline and gloss match `assets/sprites/sushi/*.png`. To change the style or a character, edit `tool/gen_prompts.dart` and run:

```bash
dart run tool/gen_prompts.dart
```

Prompts for the board tiles and the level map are in [tiles/README.md](tiles/README.md), the icons that replace the emoji in [icons/README.md](icons/README.md).

## How to use

- Model `gpt-image-1` with `size: 1024x1024`, `background: transparent`, `output_format: png` and `quality: high`.
- **Step 1.** Generate the master reference a few times and keep the best one as `<id>_master.png` (`<id>` is the character file name, such as `00-granny-sakura`).
- **Step 2.** Generate each animation sheet with the **Edit** endpoint (image → image), passing the master as the input image so the face and outfit stay the same in every frame.
- Every sheet is a **2×2 grid of 4 frames, 512×512 each**, read left→right, top→bottom (f1 f2 / f3 f4).
- Save the master and sheets in `assets/sprites/customers/<id>/source/` as `<id>_master.png` and `<anim>_sheet.png`, then cut them into 256px frames, the same size as the sushi sprites:

```bash
dart run tool/cut_sprites.dart <id>
```

- The frames land next to `source/` as `<anim>_<n>.png` (for example `00-granny-sakura/idle_0.png`), keeping the art's proportions, lined up on the feet and without any faint aura. Add the folder to `pubspec.yaml` and set `sprite:` on the customer in `lib/ui/customer_order.dart`. The boss cat goes in `assets/sprites/obstacles/` instead.
- If the frames of a sheet don't match each other, use the parts sheet at the end of each file and animate in code instead.

Customers get idle, talk, happy, sad and walk, plus one signature move. The boss cat gets the board animations from `docs/Charecter.md`: idle, prowl, eat, hit and flee.

## Quality checklist

- [ ] The background is really transparent, with no white halo around the outline. If there is one, add "no white outline around the silhouette" to the prompt and run it again.
- [ ] All 4 frames in a sheet have the same size and ground line (except hops). If not, run it again and stress "exact same size and scale".
- [ ] It reads as Japanese anime: big anime eyes with catch-lights, crisp cel shading, blush lines, anime hair locks. If it looks like a western cartoon, run it again.
- [ ] It does not look AI-generated: hands have the right fingers, both eyes match, props and accessories are clean and complete (no melted straps, buttons or patterns), shading is flat cel with no airbrushed gradients or plastic sheen, and there are no stray sparkles or random details. Fix small slips by hand in an image editor rather than re-rolling a sheet that is otherwise good.
- [ ] The character is recognisable at 64px from the silhouette alone.
- [ ] The colours match the hex codes listed in the character's file across all sheets.
- [ ] The character sits well next to `assets/sprites/sushi/salmon.png` (outline weight, shading, highlights).
